title: Odd-Cycle Span Defect: A Polynomial Lower Bound and a Square-Root Upper Bound
summary: For a graph $G$, let $ψ(G)=\max\{χ(G[V(C)]):C$ is an odd cycle of $G\}$, with $ψ(G)=0$ when $G$ is bipartite. For positive integers $N$, set $F(N)=\max\{χ(G)-ψ(G):|V(G)|\le N\}$. The function $F$ measures the finite-order additive gap arising from an open problem of Erdos and Hajnal. We prove $N^{1/6-o(1)}\le F(N)<\sqrt{6N}$. The lower bound raises the finite-order scale supplied by the Cameron-Clow path-colour construction from $\log N/\log\log N$ to a fixed power of $N$.
